This history is the project's unseen case: no model run touched it before the prompts, guidelines and scoring rules were frozen.

The pending acquisition remains visible from the May 8, 2019 report.

Announces the agreement to acquire Perrigo Animal Health and states that $145 million of new term loan financing was committed by Ares. A financing commitment is a lender decision and is withheld. It cannot be separated from the announcement sentence without editing the text, so the whole passage is withheld. The pending acquisition remains visible in this report through the chief executive's comment, the stand-alone outlook, the combined 2020 outlook and the pro forma leverage footnote.

blind_exclusions.screen_note: The keyword screen was written for waiver and amendment language. This history's lender responses are a refinancing, a note-issue permission, a definition change and a debt permission, so every passage mentioning the term loan, the lender, refinancing, convertible notes, indebtedness or headquarters was also read by hand on September 19, 2026 before these decisions were recorded.
